d:
Neeraj Kumar Win Patna MLC Election : bihar MLC chunav men patna snatak sit se JDU ke niraj kumar ne shandar jit darj ki. is sit par chunav ke dauran kaphi rajnitik charcha rahi. mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ne niraj kumar ka khuleaam virodh kiya tha aur jan suraj ke ummidvar anuj sinh ka samarthan kiya tha. chunavi natijon men anuj sinh tisre sthan par rahe.
Niraj kumar ke virodh ke bad JDU ne anant sinh ko chhah sal ke lie parti se nishkasit kar diya tha. ab patna snatak sit ke natijon ne bihar ki siyasat men is mukable ko phir charcha men la diya hai.
